scripts.demo:lab: d=$(mktemp -d) && cp -R docs/examples/tour/. "$d" && npm run lab -- "$d"
scripts.demo:vscode: d="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/myst-author-tour" && v="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/myst-author-vscode" && rm -rf "$d" && mkdir -p "$d" && cp -R docs/examples/tour/. "$d" && npm run package -w packages/vscode && set -- --user-data-dir "$v/user" --extensions-dir "$v/extensions" && code "$@" --install-extension packages/vscode/myst-author.vsix --force && code "$@" "$d" "$d/index.md"
scripts.lab: npm run build && npm run build -w packages/jupyterlab && node packages/jupyterlab/lab.mjs
scripts.vscode: npm run package -w packages/vscode && code --install-extension packages/vscode/myst-author.vsix --force
